steps.content: The defense is a complete success.

You don't even need to be there in person. With the strategy you planned in advance and the operatives you deployed, the Observation Hub is able to target the invaded fissure ahead of time and crush the Puppets, eliminating the threats while collecting a fresh batch of real-time data.
You even have the luxury of catching your breath back at the Bureau, away from the battlefield. Despite how smoothly everything has gone lately, an inexplicable weariness has settled over you.

PixelBackup37:
Still nothing after all these days? There are suspects everywhere! Take Barron from Nirvana Purchasing—his monthly reports are a disaster. Hundreds of tons of shipments with no paper trail. Then there's Osborn from the Ring Research Institute. And Ron. Which one of them isn't guilty of gross negligence? They're practically begging to be prosecuted!

PixelBackup37:
So far they've only arrested Daniel Horston from Horston Trading. A nobody! Best part? He died before they got anything useful out of him. Sounds familiar, huh? I wonder whose secrets died with him. Then again, this is the Ring Research Institute. This is Eastside—a system built by the elite, for the elite, and run by United University grads. I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Just another day around here.

PixelBackup37:
These hacks really went straight from the classroom to positions of power... And their greatest talent? Banning my accounts. Is that just how United U grads protect their precious alma mater?

PixelBackup37:
Oh, how touching! Since you bigwigs are all United U alumni, why not outsource the PR, evidence cleanup, and sockpuppet accounts to Pixel too? Together, we'll become DisCity's shining pillars, defending our glorious social values!

<color=#fb9259>Top-tier ghostwriting services cater to all disciplines! 100% privately operated and safe!</color>
<color=#fb9259>Top-tier ghostwriting services cater to all disciplines! 100% privately operated and safe!</color>

You close the forum and set aside the comms device. Well. Now you're even more exhausted.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Your predictions were accurate, Chief. Through more proactive strategic planning, we've shifted from a defensive to an offensive position against the Underground. Morale among the research staff has improved significantly as well.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: I'm pleased you were able to reach a consensus with the EDGE majority. It wasn't until you chose to prioritize the protection of the Black Ring that the Ring Research Institute was truly relieved of its pressure. Your extensive experience combating the Underground provides the most reliable support they could ask for.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: With the Sinners there, I'm not too concerned about that front. The strategy we laid out beforehand was more of a small experiment, really. I wanted to test another theory...

Halfway through your response, the black bipyramid starts rotating, its upper and lower halves separating and spinning out of sync. It's a preprogrammed gesture that activates whenever Schorl wants to flatter you or "hype you up."

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Oh? Have you formulated another bold and insightful hypothesis? You never cease to surprise. So then, my dear Chief, might I have the privilege of hearing your thought process?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My "thought process" is this: EDGE should stop wasting time on your emotional support module. You're not cut out for it. Stick to what you're actually good at.
It drops a few inches with a soft whir, seeming demoralized by your words. Only now do you finally feel a hint of perverse satisfaction.
Jump

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Oh? You...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No more flattery, Schorl. Be rational and don't waste time. I'll tell you what I'm thinking.
It freezes in midair, then starts rotating in place with a series of mechanical clicks and pops. You're not sure if it's pleased or has simply crashed from being interrupted.
end

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...The experiment was simple. After consulting with Lemma secretly, I deliberately tweaked the testing schedule to add an emergency security calibration session this afternoon, lasting half an hour. Because it was a "last-minute" change, we announced the security vulnerabilities in advance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We tampered with the test data before distributing them. The data sent to different individuals were slightly different. These inconsistencies would be hard to detect without close comparison, but were different enough for the recipients to reach different answers for the source of the security vulnerabilities after their calculations.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: ...You suspect there's a spy within the research team. You want to test them.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: So what was the outcome?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: An attack did occur today, but it didn't target any of the fabricated "vulnerabilities" we announced. The attacker avoided every single trap perfectly. They even purposely chose the most fortified point in the system to launch their assault.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you make of that result, Triangle Face?

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: ...It could be pure coincidence. It could be a communication error among the spies. It's also possible they detected the trap and changed their strategy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The spy could be operating at a high level. They had all the information at hand, yet still launched the attack as a response to our trap, mocking us. Look, they didn't even bother finding a scapegoat.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: That is indeed a possibility, but it factors in the suspect's emotional inclinations. This decision is not the direct result of rational judgment. My calculation module cannot guarantee accuracy when assessing scenarios of this nature.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: But Chief, are you hinting at someone specific? Based on your habits, I deduce that you already have a suspect in mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yet instead of investigating her, you praised her for her contributions during the defense against the attack.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: You've misunderstood. We received your report and thoroughly investigated all leads. We haven't taken more drastic action because, first of all, the investigation yielded no concrete evidence. Second...

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: We suspect everyone equally, and we monitor everyone equally. As you noted, keeping pace with the Underground's dimensional technology is critical, and the experimental costs and risks are both extremely high. Every action taken by the Ring Research Institute's personnel has to be strictly scrutinized.
That makes you realize you're under surveillance as well.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: The investigation into Isomer is still ongoing. Rest assured, you're not the only one who's filed a report against her.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Lambert and several other professors at the Ring Research Institute have been particularly proactive. They've submitted a substantial amount of documents. We're reviewing them all. Everything will be handled anonymously, of course.
Sounds like another round of infighting within the Institute. Aside from noting how quickly people are willing to turn on a fallen villain, you have little interest in getting involved.
What truly concerns you is the potential connection between Isomer and the Sillage Society.

You pull out your comms device, swipe away the million missed calls from Lemma, and search up the latest enigmatic anime clip Summer sent to you. The genius apparently devised this encryption method specifically for the operation. After decoding and translating it, the message reads:
[TOP SECRET]
Great job, Summer. This is exactly what you need.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Schorly, over here. Got some cool stuff to show you.

steps.content: Schorl drifts over eagerly. You're just about to brief it when your comms device vibrates again. That idol song starts blasting.
Wait... Did Barrie mess with your device? You barely catch who's calling before the line connects on its own.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Why did you ignore all my calls?! Didn't we agree to keep each other posted?! Weren't you supposed to personally verify everything?! I was going out of my mind!
Too late to hang up. You can only push the drifting black bipyramid a little further away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Easy, Lemma. Things are a little complicated on my end. I'm still dealing with the mess here. What about your...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Then I'll go first. We haven't finished all the calculations yet. There's still about 14% left to go. And 27 new issues cropped up today. But the results have been promising so far! We've already identified 37 suspicious locations!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Assuming the enemy has planted decoys, we're still conducting further analysis to narrow the list down. Once we've cut the number in half, we can start considering...

She enthusiastically recaps everything she already included in her messages. Pure elation radiates from her. She sounds exactly like a teenager eager to share her accomplishments and desperate for some compliments. You quickly offer a few.

options: I heard all about it. Even Summer would be impressed!
I knew you scientists had my back!
Wow, what a genius you are!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Tch, I know that already! And I'm not done yet. Listen, there's something else that really annoyed me!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Everyone at the Hub has been working their tails off! We're understaffed, and there are so many unexpected problems and a ton of calculations to be done. A few of us literally passed out after overdosing on energy drinks. We even had to pull Summer in to help. And yet... someone still had the nerve to slack off!!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Isomer! Director of the Ring Research Institute! The Observation Hub's so-called partner! And she. Never. Showed. Up. Not once! Can you believe that?!
Ah. She's probably busy being investigated right now.

She goes on ranting for a few more minutes, ending up spending more time complaining than bragging about her achievements. She seems completely oblivious to just how calculating the person she's badmouthing really is, or how treacherous the waters around her have become.
You glance at your watch. Almost time for the next phase of the operation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lemma, first off, congratulations on your breakthrough. I'm truly happy for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That said, you need to stay on guard as you progress. I know you hate all this political nonsense, but this is a very important experiment. Many pairs of eyes are on you right now. Don't let your momentum make you careless.
Sensing she's a bit put off, you quickly adjust your tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can always reach out to Professor Celine. She knows how to navigate all this, and she's great at lifting people's spirits. You like her a lot, don't you? Want me to connect you two right now?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Ah, wait...!
She stops you, and this time, her tone turns hesitant.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I wasn't just venting. I mean... We're so close to making it. We need all the help we can get, even if it comes from... Isomer...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: So I was thinking, you two used to work pretty closely, right? And your personalities are similar too. You're both calculating and shrewd. You two seem to get along... So maybe you could talk some sense into her? Get her to come back and actually contribute?
...Calculating and shrewd?
You hold back the question. You're more curious about something else.

options: I thought you two never got along?

steps.content: She falters for a moment.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: It's a critical time right now. We need all the brainpower we can get...
You fall silent. You know that's not her only reason. She seems to always expect more from talented researchers.
And the more naive Lemma sounds, the darker and more sinister Isomer's face in your memory becomes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Precisely because it's a critical time, we need to be more selective about who we choose. You know your experiment can't afford any mistakes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You need real, dedicated scientists. Isomer... her mind hasn't been on research for long. At this important juncture, don't count on someone you can't fully trust.
The other end of the line goes quiet for a long while.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's wrong, Lemma? You still there?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...No. There's more to it...
[Brief cut, scene transition]

Having remained silent throughout the entire call, Schorl finally offers a quiet reminder. It's time for you to set out with the team to track down the leads about the Sillage Society. Checking the time, you realize Schorl's right, and Lemma should be preparing for her next experiment as well.
You offer her a few final words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Focus on your work for now, Lemma. You know the root of all your recent problems is that the project hasn't been moving forward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once the experiment succeeds and your theory is validated, all that petty nonsense will be irrelevant in the face of real scientific achievement. I'm buying you time by clearing the obstacles and blocking out the noise. But the definitive blow has to come from you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Show me what a true genius can accomplish when fully focused. Once you've proven yourself, the results will speak far louder than any criticism ever could. And when that day comes, those who doubt you will make their choice accordingly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll be there for the experiment the day after tomorrow, at 4 p.m. sharp, bringing the MBCC's "super security team" and a fresh batch of field data. You'd better bring your A game too, 07. I'm counting on you to track down the Underground's nest.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Hmph, of course I won't let you down! And don't you let me down, either. Get here early and watch me make it happen.
Finally, you let out a heartfelt chuckle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Give it everything you've got, genius.
With that, you finally press the button, sending out the documents about Isomer from your device.
If she's clean, then all the better. But if she isn't... it'll be up to you to protect the real scientists.
May 29. While the Observation Hub prepares for its final verification experiment, you clean up another two suspicious hideouts on the ground.
Lemma's instructions are accurate, and your command on the field is equally impeccable. You wrap up the operation well before 3 p.m.
But you don't make it to the experiment, at last.

On May 29, N.F. 116, at 15:00, the BR-003 Observation Hub's core research team is scheduled to conduct the final verification experiment on the Mania dimension eigenvalue. According to EDGE-07's assessment, this experiment will validate her theory and make the dimensional fissure technology a reality.
At 09:00 on May 29, six hours before the final verification experiment, EDGE's Hush unit executes a secret intervention, seizing full control of the Observation Hub.
